notes: Shares = sum of all Apple (CUSIP 037833100) infoTable entries across Berkshire filing managers / other-manager combinations in each 13F-HR.

Apple 4-for-1 split effective 2020-08-31 (trading split-adjusted from 2020-08-31); periods before 2020-09-30 multiplied by 4 for split_adjusted_shares. 13F for 2020-09-30 already reports post-split shares.
Apple 7-for-1 split 2014-06-09 predates the data here (FY2014 10-K figures are already post-7:1).
13F <value> was reported in USD thousands through period 2022-09-30; from period 2022-12-31 (filed 2023-02-14) EDGAR required whole dollars. value_usd normalises to dollars.
implied_price = value_usd / shares (13F values are at quarter-end market price).
No Apple holding in the 2015Q4 13F-HR (0000950123-16-015025); first appears in 2016Q1.
Apple fundamentals: as originally reported in each fiscal-year 10-K (earliest filed XBRL fact for that fiscal-year period). EPS/share counts before FY2020 adjusted x4 / /4 for the 2020 split.

apple_derived.note_buybacks: Apple repurchase program announced March 2012; XBRL PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock is 0 for FY2011/FY2012, first cash repurchases in FY2013 (22.86B). FY2013 from 10-K 0001193125-13-416534.
